tasks.title: Submit city event permit
tasks.notes: Contact city planning department, submit form 48-A, allow 2-3 weeks for processing

tasks.title: Confirm primary caterer
tasks.notes: Get final headcount, confirm dietary restrictions, finalize menu

tasks.title: Finalize budget
tasks.notes: Collect all vendor quotes, build preliminary budget, present to committee

tasks.title: Confirm venue floor plan
tasks.notes: Get floor plan from venue, map table layouts, identify AV placement

tasks.title: Draft volunteer email
tasks.notes: Create email template, include roles, responsibilities, day-of schedule

tasks.title: Confirm AV vendor and tech specs
tasks.notes: Confirm sound system, microphones, projector if needed, backup power

tasks.title: Obtain event liability insurance
tasks.notes: Get quotes from 2-3 providers, confirm coverage amount, submit application

tasks.title: Recruit and confirm volunteers
tasks.notes: Aim for 8-10 volunteers, create role assignments, confirm attendance 1 week before

tasks.title: Finalize and distribute invitations
tasks.notes: Print/digital invites, include date/time/location/RSVP details, send to full list

tasks.title: Confirm accommodations for out-of-town guests
tasks.notes: Block hotel rooms, get group rate, create list of nearby hotels with directions
